description: AI ask batch (up to 8 prompts) — Answer up to 8 independent prompts in one GET call with the Workers AI LLM (llama-3.3-70b). Pass ?prompts= separated by || (or a JSON array of strings) and optional ?system= applied to every prompt. Returns one answer per prompt with word counts; failed items are listed with an error. Cheaper and faster than 8 separate ai/ask calls. Price: $0.04 USDC (Base, via x402).

prompts.description: e.g. What is the capital of France?||Name three primary colors.

name: ai_ask_batch
